draft.emotion: casual and practical, getting ready to step outside into the cool air
notes: Formed from เสื้อ (sɯ̂a, 'shirt/upper garment') + the English loanword แจ็กเก็ต ('jacket'). Classifier: ตัว (tua).
Compare เสื้อกันหนาว (sɯ̂a.kan.nǎːw), which refers generally to any sweater, hoodie, or coat worn for cold weather.

senses.definition: A short coat with sleeves, worn as an outer layer.
